pkgmetadata.longdescription:
NetBird is a WireGuard-based overlay network that connects machines into a single private mesh, with NAT traversal, SSO/MFA login and centrally managed access control. This package installs the prebuilt upstream release binaries: the netbird CLI/daemon and, with the "ui" USE flag, the netbird-ui desktop tray application.
Everything is shipped prebuilt from upstream's release archives, so nothing is compiled locally and no dependency tarball has to be generated or hosted.
The desktop UI could not be built from source in any case: it is a Wails 3 application whose build requires "wails3 generate bindings" and a pnpm/Vite frontend step, both of which need network access during compilation, which Portage forbids in src_compile.

use.flag: Install the netbird-ui desktop tray application (GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6). Upstream only publishes this for amd64.
